open-datum-package-applicationsopen-datu.text: The split moved the combined forms and their specs here. These rows are the only ones in the open-datum tree; the split's remaining work on the executable (the booking refusal edits Entry.hs) meets them.

scripts-and-pages.text: Checked at the second amendment and not edited by pull request 2: the recovery controls script reads only the root of a combined insert and the request of a booking receipt, none of the removed fields, and it gains rows in pull request 3; the control check script reads no fold receipt, and the controls it runs are in the conformance controls module. If a writer finds a reader of a removed field in either, that is a question before the edit.

The repair of the first hosted run swept by what consumes a fold receipt instead of by field names: every file that reads the JSON printed by registry fold, insert with fold or terminate with fold was listed with a verdict, covering scripts, the conformance package, both test suites, the application package, the Demo 1 and recovery scripts, the site check and the narration tools. Only the two-actor journey script and its status test still read a removed field; the others already read the settled list, read only the kept fields, or read no fold receipt.
No file is deleted. No file outside this table is edited.
